as_of.description: When the question was asked, a date or an RFC 3339 time: the `today` its rules see.

catalog.description: The version's sources by the names the user knows them by.

database.description: The graph the load is in.

draft_json.description:
The version's draft as JSON text: its items with their rationale (and, once rules are
evaluated, their verdicts and cards).

focus.description:
The entity the user asked it about, if any. It is read before the first step: an
entity the load holds is the question's first handle, `n1`; one it doesn't hold, or
that isn't an entity of the ontology, is said so in the question, which still runs.

goal.description: What the ontology is for: the brief of the generation that drafted it.

helix.description: The read-only proxy to the graph.

history.description: The thread's earlier questions and answers, oldest first, at most [`MAX_HISTORY`].

load.description: The load the agent reads: every read is bound to it.

models.description:
The model that answers. The endpoint's API key travels in the call's metadata, never
here.

ontology_version.description: The version the load recorded; a load of another version isn't read.

questions_json.description: The version's questions to the user, as JSON text.

request_id.description: The question's id, the same on every attempt.

visibility.description:
What the asker holds of the load, when it isn't everything: the question sees the
version and the load as those sources fill them, and reads nothing raw or historic.

AskLimits.description:
Hard caps on one question: its spend, model calls and wall time, as a turn's, and what each
of its reads of the graph may spend (`read`).

read.description:
What each read of the graph may spend, its wall time at most `max_wall_secs`. Left out,
the `Read` call's defaults (5,000 ms and 20,000 matches), which the question's wall time
still cuts short.

AskModels.description: The model a question runs on.

AskReadLimits.description:
What each read of a question may spend: a tool call's read, and each of the load profile's
reads (which also end within the profile's own time). A field left out is the `Read` call's
default, and a read's other limits are always the `Read` call's defaults. A read stopped at
one fails, its error naming the field and its value. A `helix_query` read runs inside Helix,
past these: `helix.timeout_secs` and the question's wall time bound it.

scan_entities.description:
Matches a `query` read may read into memory, at any stage, before it is too broad.
What runs inside Helix (a count, a group count or an ungrouped aggregate at the last
position of a query with no step through the rules) reads none.

wall_ms.description:
Wall time of one read, in milliseconds: its evaluation and its graph requests stop there.
At most the question's `max_wall_secs`; each graph request also ends at
`helix.timeout_secs`.

AwsRegion.description:
An AWS region, such as `us-east-1` or `ap-southeast-2`: its endpoint's host is built from
it, never typed.

AzureEndpoint.description:
An Azure OpenAI resource's endpoint: https on a host of `openai.azure.com`,
`cognitiveservices.azure.com` or `services.ai.azure.com`, with no port, user, query or
fragment, and no path but `/openai/v1`. It is kept as `{origin}/openai/v1`.

CatalogEntry.description: A source of the version, named as the user knows it.

id.description: The id mappings and routes name it by.

oneOf.description: A set of documents, extracted through routes.

CompatApi.description: The OpenAI API an OpenAI-compatible server speaks.

DocumentAccess.description: Which of a load's documents a reader holds.

Endpoint.description: The endpoint every model of a request is called on.

call_timeout_secs.description:
One JSON or text call's attempt, from connecting to its last byte, in seconds. Turns
are bounded by the request's wall time and an idle watchdog instead.

max_calls_in_flight.description:
Calls in flight on this endpoint at once, across every request, model and kind of call;
none for no endpoint-wide bound. A local server takes one or a few.

provider.description: Who serves the models, and where.

id.description:
Its identity in the load: the key's encoding for a keyed type, the normalized name for
a named one.

HelixTarget.description: Where the graph is written: the backend's proxy for one Helix database.

max_request_bytes.description: The largest request body the proxy takes; a write past it is refused before it is sent.

timeout_secs.description: How long one request may take, in seconds.

token.description: The job's bearer token for the proxy.

HistoryTurn.description: An earlier question of the thread and its answer as plain text.

LoadId.description: One load of an approved version into a graph: the id of the backend job that creates it, such as a ULID. One or more printable ASCII characters, no space.

ModelName.description:
A model's name as its provider takes it: 1 to 200 characters, none of them whitespace or a
control character.

ModelSpec.description: What a request runs a role on.

context_tokens.description:
The context window: Ollama's `num_ctx`, elsewhere a bound the prompt is checked
against.

max_output_tokens.description: The most output one response may write, under the task's own ceiling.

name.description:
The model, as the provider names it (an Azure deployment's name, a Bedrock model or
inference profile id).

reasoning.description: Send the provider's reasoning knob (Anthropic's effort, OpenAI's reasoning effort).

revision.description: The Ollama model's digest the request was tested on.

ModelUrl.description:
The base URL of a server the request names: http or https, with a host, and with no user,
password, query or fragment; a path is kept, without a trailing `/`. Whether plain http or
a private address may be called is the server's to say ([`TurnModels::check`]).

OllamaDigest.description: An Ollama model's digest: `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits.

oneOf.description: The model's row in Helix's price table.

Another model's row of the same provider kind: the model an Azure deployment runs, or
the model behind a Bedrock inference profile.
Nothing: a local or self-hosted model.

Provider.description:
Who serves a request's models, and where. Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI and Bedrock need
an API key; an Ollama server takes none; an OpenAI-compatible server may.

oneOf.description: An Azure OpenAI resource; each model is a deployment's name.
Amazon Bedrock's runtime in a region, with a Bedrock API key.
A server speaking an OpenAI API.

base_url.description: Its base URL, the version path included, such as `https://llm.example.com/v1`.

Rates.description: Per-token rates, in nano-dollars ($1 per million tokens is 1,000).

cache_read.description: Input read from the provider's prompt cache; the input rate when none.

cache_write.description: Input written to the provider's prompt cache; the input rate when none.

Visibility.description: What a reader holds of a load, as whoever serves it works out from its grants.

enrichment.description: Whether it holds People enrichment's profiles.

sets.description:
The document sets it holds a document of: a route that reads only other sets reads
nothing it holds.

sources.description: The tables and table files it holds, by the ids mappings read them by.

withheld.description: Properties someone decided from documents it doesn't hold.

WithheldProp.description: A property a reader doesn't see at all.
